title: StephenDenisEdwards/micro-x-agent-loop-python

title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: Orkas-AI/Orkas
description: Open-source multi-agent AI desktop client — build and command your AI agent team through conversation. A commander LLM dispatches sub-agents in parallel or in series; agents self-evolve via reflection and skill crystallization. Local-first, BYO LLM keys (Claude · OpenAI · Gemini · DeepSeek · Kimi · GLM · Qwen). macOS / Windows / Linux.

title: bhargavreddy-0129/LLM-agent
description: An LLM Autonomous Agent is an AI system that uses a Large Language Model to understand goals, plan tasks, make decisions, use tools such as APIs or databases, and execute actions with minimal human input. title: Dezz05/AuraSDK
description: Enable fast, local memory recall for AI agents using a lightweight, Rust-based cognitive memory engine with no cloud or LLM calls needed.

title: bxw91/brainpalace
description: Local-first RAG for code & docs with Persistent Session Memory for AI agents — BM25, vector, GraphRAG and hybrid search and a temporal knowledge graph. CLI, MCP, and a Claude Code plugin. Runs on Ollama or cloud LLMs.

title: PlawIO/veto
description: The authorization kernel for AI agents. Block, allow, or escalate agent tool calls with YAML rules — deterministic-first, LLM fallback.

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: Maaz-x14/agentic-workflow-automation-platform
description: Agentic Workflow Automation Platform, a comprehensive solution designed to simplify and automate complex tasks using local LLMs and vector DBs. A powerful tool for building and executing AI-driven workflows entirely on a local or private infrastructure.

title: d3v-sh/d3m0n-agent
description: Autonomous AI cybersecurity agent built in Go. Executes real tools — nmap, gobuster, amass, ffuf, sqlmap and more — chains them automatically based on your instructions, logs every action to SQLite, and generates professional HTML pentest reports. Works with OpenRouter or any local LLM.

title: ShrutiShravani/GuardOps
description: GuardOps is production-grade MLOps middleware framework designed to wrap volatile, probabilistic AI layers (LLM Agents, RAG retrieval paths, or complex data extraction nodes) in a strict, deterministic software shield.

title: garagon/aguara
description: Security scanner for AI agents and software supply chains. Detects prompt injection, MCP risks, tool poisoning, unsafe GitHub Actions, secret exfiltration, and compromised packages across npm, pnpm, PyPI, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Java, and .NET. Local-first, no SaaS or LLM calls.

title: grosa787/localcode
description: Local-first, Claude-Code-class AI coding assistant for your terminal and your browser. Bring any LLM (local or cloud), real tool calling with approval gates, sub-agents, memory, hooks, MCP, branching sessions, voice, PDF, whiteboard, LAN sharing. Bun + ink + Vite/React.

title: GhravenLabs/Agent-Meeting-Room
description: Flask multi-agent AI chat — @mention local LLMs (Ollama) or Claude into a live group chat with debate mode, SSE streaming, and Obsidian memory

title: ashok-kallara/semantic-daily
description: A 100% free agentic news aggregator that discovers trending AI & technology content from Native APIs (Reddit, Bluesky, GitHub, RSS, HackerNews, YouTube, and Exa.ai) — deduplicates, categorizes using a multi-agent LLM pipeline over OpenRouter, and delivers a curated daily digest directly to your Telegram or as a Web Dashboard.

title: Light-Heart-Labs/DreamServer
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: vstorm-co/summarization-pydantic-ai
description: Context Management processor for Pydantic AI agents, providing LLM-powered summarization or zero-cost sliding window trimming to handle infinite/long-running conversations without context overflow. Supports flexible triggers, safe cutoffs, and custom prompts for efficient AI apps.

title: 7yuling/ATEE
description: ATEE is a lightweight AI security agent plugin deployed on the website administrator's server or a security node within the same intranet. It connects to website requests through a thin adapter, delegates security judgments to the Core Service, and then uses a remote LLM API-driven ATEE Agent to judge and punish security cases.

title: SametAtas/rein
description: Deterministic, no-LLM guardrails for AI-written code: reproducible PASS/WARN/BLOCK verdicts an agent, a person, or CI can call.

title: tuangel134/BlackClaw
description: On-device AI agent that operates your Android phone — local or cloud LLM, ~85 tools, built-in ADB pairing, OCR, auto-replies. Beta.
